Remote-workstation handoff, verified 2026-10-06. Published code checkpoint: 05871cbb145424e29daefed3380814f0b2a0016e on feat/native-surface-transforms; GitHub branch SHA matches. Surface slice is not merged into master or released. This note supersedes pending CI/old checkpoint statements in earlier notes; later metadata-only handoff commits do not change the tested code.

Completed: V1 nonlinear MNI152NLin6Asym <-> MNI152NLin2009cAsym volume transforms, qualified on 1/2 mm grids, public discovery/cache/application APIs and published transform-artifacts-v1 release. Surface slice implemented: surface_domain, surface_geometry, surface_data, get_surface_transform and apply_surface_transform; exact geometry/topology/hemisphere/registration/mask binding, continuous/label/probability semantics, missingness/coverage and integrity-checked operator cache.

Scientific scope: only pinned fsaverage164k <-> registered fsLR32k, both hemispheres, native_closest_barycentric. Portable replay: 1362 exhaustive independent oracle queries, max weight error 3.4083846855992306e-14, zero sampled label/availability mismatches, full-density policy checks and tamper rejection pass. No universal Workbench equivalence, anatomical accuracy, inverse or area-conservation claim. Historical Workbench strict gate failures remain: 3/4 ordinary cases, 17 near-edge disagreements.

Final engineering evidence at code SHA 05871cbb145424e29daefed3380814f0b2a0016e: https://github.com/bbuchsbaum/neuroatlas/actions/runs/37410069997 completed SUCCESS; macOS release, Windows release, Ubuntu devel and Ubuntu oldrel all passed. This supersedes the earlier 915b8e1 Windows test failure. Local full suite 2674 pass/0 fail/45 warnings/5 optional or opt-in skips. R CMD check --as-cran --no-manual with unavailable optional Suggests explicitly allowed: 0 errors/1 CRAN incoming warning/0 notes; examples, installed tests and vignette rebuild pass; PDF manual unverified. Checklist at the same SHA fails external org lookup: https://github.com/bbuchsbaum/neuroatlas/actions/runs/37410070017. Remaining quality failures are tracked in bd-01M47HZ11AWSD23BCAB6NXNXGY; whole repository is not green.

Next: rebuild isolated engine pinned to 933edddda462593941e167726e8aaa7168ff103a on the new workstation and run checks, then review exact domain/method route admission and per-asset redistribution licenses; generic surface aliases and other densities stay planned. Registration-fusion MNI-to-cortex mapping and aligned ribbon sampling are separate unfinished work. CIFTI/subcortex and directed surface-to-volume follow later.

Resume from GitHub feature branch, not master. Tracked instructions: plans/resume-neuroatlas.md and plans/template-transform-coverage.md. Evidence: data-raw/surface-transforms-v1/qualification/resume-20261006 and windows-portability-20261006; historical report native-qualification.md. On a fresh clone, install Mote CLI separately, mkdir -p .mote/local .mote/tmp, set a distinct machine actor, run mote doctor and mote board; do not mote init. Shared .mote/FORMAT.json and ops are Git-tracked; local actors/tmp, downloaded inputs and operator caches are not. Rebuild machine-specific engine hashes rather than copying old binaries/receipts. Local fresh-GitHub-clone reconstruction has passed; destination workstation itself has not yet been configured or tested. No outstanding cluster jobs or active implementation leases at handoff.
